text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel seized 1st place in the 
Japan Cup. Just as she had declared, she 
displayed her brilliance to Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What Narita Brian found was a new light. 
To grasp it, she broke free of her old 
self and stepped out from the dark.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel and Narita Brian had become 
rivals, each chasing and being chased by 
the other.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And at the Arima Kinen, Mayano Top Gun, 
Marvelous Sunday, and Hishi Amazon will 
surely gather as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Faced with such formidable rivals, Sakura 
Laurel's heart leapt with excitement. She 
began preparing meticulously for the Arima 
Kinen.
